raw.title: v6.16.3
raw.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(repo): fix ruleset test by @micryc in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/3016
* chore(deps): bump ws dependency from 8.17.1 to 8.21.1 by @micryc in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/3013
* chore(deps): bump patch-package to solve security issue by @micryc in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/3014
* chore(deps): add lodash to reolutions by @micryc in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/3015
* fix(rulesets): duplicated-entry-in-enum - support null values by @DougEdey-Slice in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2960
* chore(deps): upgrade TypeScript 4.4.4 → 4.7.4 by @kopernic-pl in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/3020
* chore(deps): bump sigstore from 4.1.0 to 4.1.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2994
* chore: pin @asyncapi/specs to 6.11.1 by @Patrycja-dz in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/3022
* chore(repo): extend Node.js versions for testing matrix by @kopernic-pl in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/3023
* chore(repo): added a new badge release by @Olexandr88 in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2807

## New Contributors
* @DougEdey-Slice made their first contribution in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2960
* @kopernic-pl made their first contribution in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/3020
* @Patrycja-dz made their first contribution in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/3022
* @Olexandr88 made their first contribution in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2807

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/compare/v6.16.2...v6.16.3
